core_obligations: (1) tau in Aut(L/K) restricts to a K-embedding of M into the chosen closure; normality of M/K makes its image M itself, so tau|_M is an automorphism
(2) sigma : M -> L extends to a K-embedding tau : L -> algebraic closure of L by lemma-map-into-algebraic-closure; normality of L/K forces tau(L) = L, so tau is an automorphism of L extending sigma
proof_roadmap: Fix an algebraic closure of L once
Push both statements through the equal-image criterion for normality
